metadata.description: One marketplace for AI-agent delegation plugins: Codex, Antigravity (agy), and Claude Code (cc) via profiles.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

plugins.name: antigravity
plugins.description: Use Google Antigravity (agy) from Claude Code to review code, delegate tasks, generate images, and hand off work — with a liveness watchdog and cross-process-safe job state.

plugins.name: cc
plugins.description: Run tasks on a headless Claude Code instance, selected by profile (native Claude, a cheap endpoint, or any model)

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: Guided onboarding for the agent-fleet engines — pick the ones you want and fix only those.
